info.title: Healthcare Plus Platform API
info.description: A comprehensive RESTful API for managing patient records, appointments, medical records, and prescriptions within a multi-tenant hospital system. Designed with HIPAA compliance, HL7 FHIR compatibility, and robust access controls to ensure the security and privacy of Protected Health Information (PHI). All patient data access is subject to audit logging and requires explicit consent management. This API supports role-based access for admin, doctor, nurse, and receptionist roles.
